trigger: Rourke's burros stuck at the blockade (q_rourke_escort).

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: My friend! Help an old man. Maisie won't walk past the soldiers and the soldiers won't walk past Maisie.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Get us through the canyon and I'll give you the best thing I own. A rumor. A good one.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Here's my rumor, worth every step: the fenced place in Dixie Valley has its own power. Hardened. Military.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Whatever's out there came from inside that fence. Ask the sheepmen. Ask anybody who's been east.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Ah. Another time. Maisie forgives. I hold grudges for her.
